20219.long_desc:
Our largest 4:3 1440x1080 resolution Arcooda LCD arcade monitor is a massive 35inches, making it perfect to replace your CRT tube or rear projection arcade monitors. Supports native 15khz, 24khz and 31khz arcade games as well as offering the ability to run the latest arcade games in high definition. Highly suitable for Pedestal, split screen, showcase cabinets, as well as driving and arcade cabinets with larger CRT tube monitors. ARCADE MACHINE & GAMING INDUSTRY
  • supports multiple variations of 15khz, 25kz, 31khz, arcade gaming resolutions.
  • V36 firmware, over 10 years of constant firmware upgrades offering the widest possible support for most arcade game boards on "plug and play basis". From Sega Model 3, to Midway, Namco System 257, Sega Chihiro and your standard JAMMA arcade game boards.
  • auto picture function that works, tuned with real arcade game boards. Just press the auto button for perfect centering of your arcade picture.
  • multiple mounting options including angle brackets (included) rear mounting connection, and VESA mount. This offers the widest mounting options.
  • breakout OSD monitor control board (optional). Mount the monitor adjustment board where it matters, in front of you.
  • RGB adapter PCB (optional) for plug and play with almost any CRT tube monitor wiring. This board also offers fine tuning of color via red,blue,green color potentiometers
  • full angle viewing is perfect for all arcade machines.
  • multiple screen adjustments including picture rotate function.
    • This is our recommended 35inch monitor for arcade machine restoration/building as color reproduction has been tuned to our highly regarded 32inch 16:9 ratio arcade monitor. It is perfectly suited for 38inch CRT tube monitor replacement. HOME RETRO & PC GAMING
  • 1.5ms display lag
  • over 150 pre-programmed PC input modes including 240p, 480p, 720p, up to 1440x1080
  • Freesync, Ultra HDR, DDCCI, UltraVivid, plus other monitor display settings
  • offering full display angle viewing with 16.7M color reproduction, 1200:1 contrast ratio
  • VESA mounting for easy desktop mounting
  • connect Steam or other gaming libraries via Displayport, for HD gaming
  • connect breakout speakers via the 3.5mm audio jack
  • remote control function (optional)
    • PLEASE NOTE: this monitor has a slightly wider bezel compared to our 35inch 2880x2160 monitor. Please refer to photos. The Arcooda arcade monitor firmware has been refined over many years.
